entries.13b53509b1120d70: Built on strong partnerships with accounting firms, it has a structure of extending financial and accounting systems that are data-compatible with the accounting firm product line to client companies. It has a locally rooted direct sales and support structure through 33 sales and support locations nationwide, and an after-sales service structure that includes TVS, a comprehensive maintenance service for accounting firms, and 24-hour, 365-day telephone inquiry support.
